subject: Renewal: restructure monthly commit & 8→16 GPU upgrade
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@edgeai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@edgeai.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal window & request to uplift committed capacity

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well — our renewal is coming up in June and we’ve been evaluating next year’s capacity needs. Usage has spiked and the product team is asking whether we can double our reserved pool from 8→16 GPUs while preserving a similar monthly spend profile.

Primary asks from procurement and engineering:
- Can we expand to 16 GPUs with an updated monthly commit that phases the spend over the term?
- We need a throughput guarantee (p99 latency under 180ms for 128-token requests) and a fall-back plan if capacity contention occurs.
- Procurement will need a simple billing cadence (monthly invoice) and a contact for SLA sign-off.

I’ve attached the decision roster the stakeholders filled out. Happy to jump on a call if easier.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Director, Platform Engineering
EdgeAI Inc.

Attachment: EdgeAI_Decision_Roster.xlsx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@edgeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window & request to uplift committed capacity

Thanks Samantha — this is great context. Quick answers up front: yes, we can move from 8→16 reserved GPUs for the renewal term, and we can present a couple of commercial structures that keep monthly invoices sensible while protecting both sides.

Proposal highlights (high level):
- Option A — Flat commit: 16 GPUs, single monthly commit (simple, best for predictable throughput).
- Option B — Phased commit: months 1–3 at 10 GPUs (pro-rata), months 4–12 at 16 GPUs (staged activation) with blended monthly invoices.

SLO/throughput: we can guarantee 99th-percentile latency <= 180ms for 128-token requests on the dedicated pool when the pool is healthy; we’ll include an SLA clause and a 72-hour remediation window for capacity contention. If we can’t meet the SLO due to supply constraints, automated routing to a compatible model variant in a different pool will kick in (at a controlled cost delta).

Next steps: I’ll loop in Connor from Infrastructure to validate activation lead times and Marissa to review commercial adjustments. If EdgeAI prefers the phased route, we’ll draft a proposed amendment and a DocuSign-ready SLA.

Would you prefer a short sync this week or should we exchange a written draft?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Dedicated Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window & request to uplift committed capacity

Adding a couple notes for the amendment draft:
- Commercial: If EdgeAI signs Option B (phased), we should include a modest uplift on months 1–3 (10 GPUs) to account for activation overhead — recommend +5% on those months only.
- Billing: monthly invoices, but include pro-rata line items for partial-month activations. Finance prefers simple line descriptions so procurement can map to their POs.
- Credits: offer a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to 2 weeks of 8-GPU run-rate to offset their migration/testing cost.

Karthik — can you confirm whether we have inventory that can guarantee full 16-GPU activation by the start of month 4? Connor, please confirm estimated lead time for staged activation (weeks).

—Marissa
Senior Renewals Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T12:52:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity uplift feasibility

We can commit to the phased activation as long as EdgeAI accepts a short lead time for full pool readiness. Current estimate: 3–4 weeks to validate image/config and warm KV caches for additional capacity, and an additional week for ops-runbook sign-off. So month 4 activation is feasible if contract countersigned by end of May.

Operational guarantees we need in the amendment:
- Activation window dates (mutually agreed) with rollback procedures.
- Throughput verification plan using customer-provided synthetic traces and a 48-hour verification window post-activation.
- Fallback routing policy spelled out (percentage of traffic that may be redirected and cost deltas).

Connor — please confirm whether there are any region constraints (EdgeAI uses us-west primarily).

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Infrastructure Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@edgeai.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@edgeai.com>, EdgeAI Procurement <procurement@edgeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Amendment draft + DocuSign & next steps

Samantha / Carlos — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the amendment draft and a clean SLA PDF with the p99 latency clause and activation milestones. Key commercial points we agreed on:
- Term: 12 months from effective date.
- Commit structure: Phased (Option B) — months 1–3 billed at 10 GPUs (pro-rated), months 4–12 billed at 16 GPUs.
- Pricing: +5% uplift on months 1–3 to cover activation overhead; blended monthly invoices thereafter.
- One-time onboarding credit issued in the first invoice (equivalent to two weeks of 8-GPU run-rate).
- SLA: p99 latency <= 180ms for 128-token requests; 72-hour remediation for capacity SLO misses; 48-hour verification window post-activation.
- Activation schedule: target full 16-GPU readiness by 2027-09-01 contingent on countersignature by 2027-05-31.

Attached: Signed_SLA_draft.pdf (for procurement), and I’ve created a DocuSign packet that contains the amendment and signature page — link below. If that timeline works, we’ll get the countersign and begin the activation checklist.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/packet/EDGE-2027-REN-047

Please reply with approval or a single set of edits and I’ll route for signatures. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to finalize.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Dedicated Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Signed_SLA_draft.pdf
